kilde: Digital Education Resource Archive (University College London)
sammendrag: Greg Brooks wrote chapters 1, 2 (except section 2.3), 4, 7 (except section 7.5.2) and 10-15 (except sections 11.8, 12.8 and 13.5), most of the material on basic skills in prisons (including sections 3.4.9and 6.5), sections 3.7, 6.10-11 and 8.3-5, and the aims, sources, summary and recommendations sections of all other chapters, and edited all the contributions.Kerry Giles wrote up most of the material on numeracy (especially sections 7.4.2 and 8.6-7 and the Annex to chapter 8) and on the use of ICT in teaching basic skills (especially sections 8.8 and 13.5), did the systematic library search (including obtaining material through inter-library requests and searching the Register of Educational Research), and assembled batches of material for other authors to analyse.John Harman wrote up most of the material on motivation, etc., and some of that on provision and programmes, including sections 5.3-8, 6.7 (part), 6.8-9 and 6.12.Sally Kendall wrote up most of the material on provision by employers and in the workplace, including sections 3.5, 6.7 (part), 11.8 and 12.8.Felicity Rees wrote part of section 9.4 and most of sections 2.3 and 3.3-4 (including Tables 3.1-3).Sara Whittaker carried out and documented all the database searches and almost all the internet searches (see the Appendix).
tittel: Assembling the fragments : a review of research on adult basic skills
